a: $5,000 cash prize plus membership in the Cottrell Scholar community (eligible for Cottrell STAR, IMPACT and SEED awards)
dt: Nomination package due Nov 4, 2026 (submitted by the nominating Cottrell Scholar or Holland awardee via the RCSA PRISM portal)
e: Recognizes tenured faculty in chemistry, physics or astronomy (or closely related physical sciences) at a US or Canadian research university or primarily undergraduate institution with strong records in research, teaching, mentoring and leadership. Nomination by a Cottrell Scholar or Holland awardee only (no self-nominations); past Cottrell Scholars are not eligible.
n: RCSA Robert Holland Jr. Award for Research and Leadership Excellence
unv: The Nov 4, 2026 date comes from the Awards Calendar on the RCSA Cottrell Scholars page; the award page itself does not restate the deadline or a time of day.
